# deezy encode dd

Dolby Digital (AC-3) at 1.0, 2.0, 5.0 or 5.1. `deezy bitrates dd` lists the data rates. See also [Dolby Digital](../formats/dd.md).

  --lo-ro-surround, {-1.5,-3,-4.5,-6,-inf}

## Examples

- Delay the audio by 150 ms (the `=` in `--delay=` is required):

```bash
deezy encode dd --delay=150ms movie.mkv
```

- Stereo at 192 kbps with a Dolby Pro Logic II downmix:

```bash
deezy encode dd --channels 2 --stereo-down-mix dpl2 --bitrate 192 movie.mkv
```

- Code 5.1 as 5.0, without the LFE:

```bash
deezy encode dd --disable-lfe movie.mkv
```

- Reuse the temp files of an earlier run of the same command:

```bash
deezy encode dd --reuse-temp-files movie.mkv
```
